name: grimborne-hunters
description: Grimborne Hunters: Castle of Ash — 3D dark-fantasy Soulslike action RPG (Web / Yandex Games / Android Capacitor)

scripts.build:www: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root = (Get-Location).Path; $www = Join-Path $root 'www'; if (Test-Path $www) { Remove-Item $www -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $www | Out-Null; Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'index.html'), (Join-Path $root 'manifest.json') -Destination $www; foreach ($d in @('css','js','vendor')) { Copy-Item (Join-Path $root $d) -Destination (Join-Path $www $d) -Recurse }; $assetsDest = Join-Path $www 'assets'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $assetsDest | Out-Null; Copy-Item (Join-Path $root 'assets\*') -Destination $assetsDest -Recurse -Force; Get-ChildItem $www -Recurse -File -Include '*.blend','*.blend1','*.bak*' | Remove-Item -Force; foreach ($drop in @('audio\candidates','cover.png')) { $p = Join-Path $assetsDest $drop; if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item $p -Recurse -Force } }; $mb = [math]::Round(((Get-ChildItem $www -Recurse -File | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum) / 1MB, 2); Write-Host ('www/ ready (' + $mb + ' MiB)')"
scripts.cap:copy: npm run build:www && npx cap copy android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
